sentence: This project studies how the gut microbiota affects tumor growth and the response to immunotherapy.
This project uses cancer mouse models and 3D spheroids to study how osteosarcoma, breast, liver and prostate cancers arise.
This project builds a low-cost blood test that measures several biomarkers of hepatocellular carcinoma, a liver cancer.
This project tests whether a technology-based program using in-home sensors can lower the risk of falls in older adults with mild cognitive impairment.
This project tries to find out which cell types and pathways lead to chronic kidney disease.
This project offers light and electron microscopy imaging for studying how cells, tissue and bio-engineered materials are organized.
This project tests whether vitamin C protects the brain over the long term in rodents of both sexes with traumatic brain injury.
This project studies how extracellular matrix problems lead to more lipid and less anti-oxidative capacity in human retinal pigment epithelial cells.
This project studies what an uncharacterized nuclear protein does in vascular smooth muscle cells linked to occlusive vascular diseases.
This project studies which genes explain how caloric restriction changes cognitive aging in mice, and whether they matter in humans.
This project studies whether advanced chest imaging and blood testing can find patients at high risk of worsening interstitial lung disease.
This project studies how blood cells that lose the Y chromosome speed up aging through changes in immune cell function.
This project studies how age-related epigenetic changes drive colon cancer, using mouse models and gene editing.
This project studies how proteins made by bacterial viruses called phages disable the CRISPR-Cas systems that protect bacteria.
This project tries to find out why immunotherapy works for only some lung cancer patients, and builds a clinical test to predict it.
This project tests whether a way of analyzing MRI images, called diffusion histology imaging, can diagnose prostate cancer without invasive biopsies.
This project studies how mechanical loading stimulates muscle growth and glucose metabolism.
This project studies infants with monogenic risk for autism to see how learning of that risk early affects parents and neurodevelopmental trajectories.
This project builds tools that make nonhuman primate models more reliable for testing genetic and regenerative therapies.
This project tests whether magnetic particle imaging can track dendritic cell vaccines as they move to lymph nodes.
